prerequisites: This course can only be taken after (almost) all course units of the preceding training phase have been successfully completed.

The bachelor's thesis cannot be included in the individual annual program of a student who still has to complete a limited part of a preceding training phase. An exception applies when the student includes both a limited number of remaining course units from the preceding training phase and all course units from the last training phase in their individual annual program.

learning_outcomes.text: The student demonstrates analytical and synthetic ability and independent problem-solving ability at the level of a novice professional.
The work reflects the general critical-reflective attitude and research-oriented attitude of the student.
To solve a real problem from the professional context at the level of a novice professional.
To report the solution to the problem in a thesis.
To present the solution to the problem to a jury of lecturers and external professionals.
To defend the solution to the problem before a jury of lecturers and external professionals.
You analyze a practical problem and formulate a clear problem statement, objective, and program of requirements, aligned with the client's request.
You develop a high-quality, technically sound solution or design that meets the stated requirements.
You clearly and correctly justify technical choices and insights, using acquired technical knowledge, analysis, and research.
You implement and validate the solution via a functional model (realization) or prototype, and document the development and realization process correctly and completely.
You communicate clearly, professionally, and target-group-oriented about the developed product and process, in written, visual, and oral form.
You show entrepreneurship and initiative in seeking solutions and in independently managing your project progress.
You independently plan, monitor, and optimize your project approach, work qualitatively, solution-oriented, and adjust based on your own insight or feedback.
You work constructively with all stakeholders, with attention to professional interaction.

syllabus_topics: Working on a concrete, real problem from a company or organization
Process and work attitudes (full-time presence, respecting agreements and deadlines, independent work, close consultation, result-oriented work, quality checking, adjusting plans, regular reporting)
Developing a design and/or practical realization of a technical subject
Writing a thesis and poster about the solution and the search for the solution
Presenting and defending the solution orally before a jury
teaching_methods: Individual initiative in finding a project
Fixed feedback moments with company promoter and university promoter
Information sessions on thesis writing and presentation skills

assessment_methods.method: Process (Work attitude in the company, assessed by company promoter)
Process (Administration and adherence to deadlines, assessed by bachelor's thesis coordinator)
Process (Progress and planning, assessed by jury of lecturers)
Product (Final product/realization, assessed by company promoter)
Product (Final product/realization, assessed by a jury of lecturers and externals)
Product (Thesis, assessed by a jury of lecturers and externals)
Product (Final presentation, assessed by a jury of lecturers and externals)
Product (Oral defense during final presentation, assessed by a jury of lecturers and externals)

assessment_rules: The final score for the course is determined by the result on the Process (8 ECTS, 27.5% of the final result) and the result on the Product (22 ECTS, 72.5% of the final result). A score lower than 10/20 on the Product component (final realization) means the student can achieve a maximum of 9/20 for the entire course. Failure to submit the thesis results in a maximum score of 9/20 for the course. For the resit, the score for the 'Process' component from the first examination opportunity is carried over. The 'Product' component is re-examinable, requiring a new thesis submission and a new final presentation + defense before a jury.
